prompt:
Make a NEW KFB soft claymation ink blob character sheet, The Insect Hotel. The original reference PNGs guide the intact charcoal-plum goo anatomy, expressive filled sculpted eyelids, cream white sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, and miniature prop modeling. Exactly six independent footless complete upright ink blobs in a 3-column by 2-row horizontal 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. All props held or attached to their own body, all detached droplets inside generous gutters and canvas margins. No stage, floor, scenery, backdrop color, panel borders, text, labels or logos. Smooth softly satin clay with larger sparse hand-shaped marks, quiet cloth folds and clean smooth glass or glossy material. Avoid dense stipple, grit and crust. Keep organic thick rounded goo shapes and whole ink silhouette dominant, with minimal distinct costume or thematic prop. Teeth sit behind lips. Wide range of eyes, body attitudes and mouth shapes. Style and palette: Golden amber, moss green and russet, compact insect cues on dark ink blobs. The role cast in row-major order:
1. Female-read moth guest. round droplet, captivated high gaze, open delighted smile. One compact cue: short rounded fuzzy antenna accents and a tiny bedside lamp held in hand.
2. Male-read beetle porter. low wide mass, firm eyes, strained mouth. One compact cue: two small beetle-shell shoulder plates and a smooth luggage ball on a short strap.
3. Female-read bee at pollen customs. upright curl, suspicious side-eye and closed pout. One compact cue: small amber jar and oversized clean rubber stamp.
4. Male-read reception clerk. broad squared splat, calm eyes and flat lips. One compact cue: three bundled hollow reeds with tiny blank room tags.
5. Male-read laundry attendant. tall soft oval, droopy lids and narrow smile. One compact cue: tiny folded cocoon-shaped blanket held at waist.
6. Male-read night porter. crooked pear, inquisitive eyes and a small gasp. One compact cue: little leaf-shaped call bell with brass knob.
Six distinct readable stand-alone figures, original archetypal props, very clear alpha gutters. No copied reference costume, wings or eyepatches.
